title: A piano you set up on a stage.
line: Four pianos from real recordings, from a concert grand with its lid open to a felt-damped upright. Place the microphones where they really stood, choose the hall, and open a score page that plays MusicXML and MIDI and writes your own. Free 30-day trial, then it keeps playing for free with the upright. $29.99 until 1 January 2027 (regular $49), standalone app, VST3 and AU, macOS and Windows.
alt: The AHENK panel: a grand piano on a stage with microphones placed around it
